2607.02423.title: Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning for LLMs
2607.02423.paper_summary: Active Few-Shot Learning (AFSL) adapts LLMs to specialized domains by identifying the most valuable unlabeled samples for annotation and use as few-shot demonstrations, effectively reducing human annotation costs while promoting high performance. However, existing methods typically rely on output-level signals for sample identification, such as predictive entropy or semantic similarities with test-time data based on external embeddings, which often overlook models' internal dynamics, which could pinpoint specific knowledge gaps. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuFS, a Neuron-Aware Active Few-Shot Learning framework that shifts the selection paradigm from output-level proxies to models' internal dynamics. NeuFS utilizes neuron activation patterns to represent sample directly, and includes a dual-criteria selection strategy that: (1) ensures few-shot sample diversity with neuron patterns for broader example coverage, while (2) prioritizing on identifying informative and challenging few-shot samples LLMs tend to hallucinate by quantifying neuron consensus. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that NeuFS excels in both reasoning and text classification tasks, outperforming existing AFSL baselines. Ablation studies further highlight that internal neuron activations provide a more principled and effective selection signal than external embeddings, validating the superiority of the proposed NeuFS.
2607.02423.paper_summary_zh: 主動少樣本學習（AFSL）通過識別最有價值的未標記樣本進行標註，並用作少樣本示範，將大型語言模型（LLMs）適應於專業領域，有效降低人類標註成本，同時促進高性能。 然而，現有方法通常依賴於輸出級信號來進行樣本識別，例如預測熵或基於外部嵌入的測試時數據的語義相似性，這往往忽視了模型的內部動態，這可能指出特定的知識缺口。 為了填補這一空白，我們提出了NeuFS，一種神經元感知的主動少樣本學習框架，將選擇範式從輸出級代理轉向模型的內部動態。 NeuFS利用神經元激活模式直接表示樣本，並包括一種雙標準選擇策略：（1）確保少樣本樣本的多樣性，利用神經元模式以擴大示例覆蓋範圍，同時（2）優先識別LLMs傾向於幻想的有信息且具挑戰性的少樣本樣本，通過量化神經元共識來實現。 在三個數據集上的實驗表明，NeuFS在推理和文本分類任務中表現出色，超越了現有的AFSL基準。 消融研究進一步強調，內部神經元激活提供了比外部嵌入更具原則性和有效性的選擇信號，驗證了所提出的NeuFS的優越性。
